title: The vibe knit carries the continuous group SU(3)

statements.text: The knit carries the symmetry of the strong force, the continuous group SU(3).
statements.scope: symmetry. status derived and negative. category measurement (a measured property of the committed knit itself, compared with nothing in nature. Worth: what the program is, including what it lacks). depth L1, L2 and L3 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed. L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model. L3: one base rule produced the result as a measured consequence, with a computed control that could have failed)
statements.conditions: The hypothesis R-FRC-0003 tested, stated from its question: Does the knit carry the symmetry of the strong force? Its answer: The knit before 2026-09-25 carried none of it: the charge U(1) and the phase, no $\mathbb{Z}_3$, no $S_3$, and coarse-graining brought none back. The adopted three-trit knit carries the classical color group $\Sigma(648)$ on its links and keeps color exact dock by dock, pair creation included. It does not carry the continuous SU(3). $\Sigma(648)$ is finite, and SU(3) is reached only as the closure of circuits that include the fear beat. Limits: the color readings are made on the dock grid of the 4D bulk, on side-3 boxes, not read on the 3D husk (E-RLT-0067 states it). the held color is read on the pair-making isometric knit with the token-returning store (E-RLT-0067). The lone bounce collision and the coset-union vacuum the later experiments run (E-RLT-0084, E-RLT-0093) report no held-color reading, and the doublet-locked stream adopted on 2026-09-26 is not built. the store keeps 24 role points per dock beside its 12 store trits, registers beyond the three trits per slot (E-RLT-0067). $\Sigma(648)$ is finite. Under a Wilson action with a $\operatorname{Re} \operatorname{Tr} U^2$ term it matches SU(3) at the $N_t = 4$ transition, and on the trajectories measured its spacing stops shrinking there (E-FRC-0103). that $\Sigma(648)$ with any one element of SU(3) outside it generates a dense subgroup of SU(3) is a theorem from the classification of the finite subgroups of SU(3) (L5), not measured on the rule. Measured are the Lie algebras of two gate sets: $\mathfrak{su}(3)$ from $\Sigma(648)$ and the qutrit T gate, the method check of E-QTM-0118, and $\mathfrak{su}(9)$ from $\Sigma(648)$ on each role and the fear beat (E-QTM-0118, E-FRC-0127). density is not nearness. One fear beat between classical words gives no step finer than $\Sigma(648)$, and the first word closer to the qutrit T gate than any classical element needs 4 fear beats, 0.362 against 0.395, at $2^8$ of grain (E-QTM-0101, E-QTM-0104). the negative half is the pre-2026-09-25 knit only, the turning weave of code/rule/collision.ts. For it, coarse variables other than block populations, spread three-vibe starts and windows beyond 8 beats are untested, and time-reversed and dock-dependent symmetries are excluded by design. Launch gate. Pass: novel, derived, quantitative, auditable, interesting. Fail: prior_art_reviewed, differentiating, falsifiable, skeptic_reviewed, independently_reproduced. Unknown: none. Novelty: apparently_new. Free parameters: 0. Fitted: false. Known before: false.
